I booked my ticket from Rishikesh to New Delhi, and it was a great travel experience. The Volvo bus was extremely comfortable, making the journey relaxing and enjoyable. The pricing was also very reasonable and offered excellent value for money. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a comfortable and affordable trip!

Overall, it was a very disappointing and unpleasant experience for me. When I boarded the bus, my seat was already occupied by another passenger and was in an extremely unhygienic condition. When I requested the staff to change the bedsheet and prepare the seat, I was informed that no extra bedsheets or pillow covers were available. Instead, they simply flipped the used sheet and asked me to use it, which is completely unacceptable.
Initially, the bus conductor was not supportive at all. It was only after I raised a complaint with the office that some action was taken, but even then, the resolution provided was far from satisfactory.

Additionally, the interior design of the bus is poorly planned. For instance, the staircase to the upper deck is positioned near the head area of the lower berth, making it extremely uncomfortable and unhygienic, as passengers going upstairs could easily put their feet near someone’s face.
The cabins are also poorly designed — they are fully enclosed with sliding doors and have no curtains or proper ventilation, making it feel suffocating.
To make matters worse, I noticed bed bugs in the bus, which raises serious concerns about hygiene and maintenance. The washroom had no water, adding further inconvenience during the journey.

Despite charging a high fare, the overall experience was comparable to a third-class general coach. Moreover, the staff allowed local passengers to enter the bus and sit on the floor between seats, creating overcrowding and discomfort, similar to an unreserved train compartment, where even accessing the washroom becomes difficult.

This level of service is completely unacceptable given the price charged.
